Portrait Frame - Chest-Up.name: Portrait Frame - Chest-Up
Portrait Frame - Chest-Up.description:
🖼️ Portrait Framing: Chest-Up
A close character portrait with the complete head, shoulders and upper outfit visible.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Portrait Frame - Chest-Up.traitNarrativeEffects: Vertical chest-up portrait from the top of the hair through the upper chest. Keep the complete head, hair silhouette, face, neck, shoulders, collar, and upper outfit inside the canvas with small margins above the hair and around both shoulders. Do not crop the head or hair. Do not show the waist, hips, legs, or footwear. Do not tighten into face-only framing or expand to waist-up, knee-up, three-quarter-body, or full body.
